name: Stripe
tagline: Stripe's full product surface, line by line — which products are judged in an arena of their own, and which have no arena where they honestly compete yet.

subProducts.name: Payments
subProducts.blurb: Online payment acceptance: cards, wallets, 100+ local methods, hosted Checkout, Payment Links, and embeddable Elements.

subProducts.name: Terminal
subProducts.blurb: In-person payments with card readers and smart terminals, unified with online payments in one dashboard and API.

subProducts.name: Atlas
subProducts.blurb: Delaware C corp or LLC incorporation from anywhere: state filing, EIN, founder equity, 83(b) election, and legal templates for a $500 one-time fee.

subProducts.name: Clerky
subProducts.blurb: Startup legal paperwork platform (incorporation, SAFEs, board consents, hiring docs) — a Stripe company, judged as its own product in the same arena as Atlas.
subProducts.acquired: Acquired by Stripe (2026) — still operates and competes as its own product

subProducts.name: Billing
subProducts.blurb: Subscription management and recurring billing: plans, trials, usage-based pricing, revenue recovery, and dunning.
subProducts.note: No subscriptions/billing arena yet, and Stripe's billing capability is already judged inside its payments entry (recurring-subscription-billing, dunning, hosted-invoice stories) — a second Stripe row on the same rails would double-list, not inform.

subProducts.name: Invoicing
subProducts.blurb: Global invoicing for one-off and subscription charges with hosted payment pages and automatic reconciliation.
subProducts.note: Sold as part of Billing; the send-hosted-invoices story is judged inside Stripe's payments entry.

subProducts.name: Connect
subProducts.blurb: Multi-party payments for platforms and marketplaces: seller onboarding, split charges, and payouts.
subProducts.note: No platform-payments arena; the marketplace-split-payments story is judged inside Stripe's payments entry.

subProducts.name: Radar
subProducts.blurb: Machine-learning fraud prevention with risk scoring, custom rules, and review queues on every charge.
subProducts.note: No fraud-prevention arena yet; the fraud-screening-rules story is judged inside Stripe's payments entry.

subProducts.name: Tax
subProducts.blurb: Automated sales tax, VAT, and GST calculation, registration monitoring, and filing.
subProducts.note: No tax-compliance arena yet; the automatic-tax-calculation story is judged inside Stripe's payments entry.

subProducts.name: Issuing
subProducts.blurb: Create and manage virtual and physical cards programmatically, including stablecoin-backed card programs.
subProducts.note: No card-issuing arena yet — nothing honest to rank it against.

subProducts.name: Treasury
subProducts.blurb: Banking-as-a-service API for platforms to embed financial accounts: store, spend, and move money (US/UK preview).
subProducts.note: An embedded-finance API for platforms, not an account a startup opens directly — the startup-banking arena ranks banks you can sign up for, so listing Treasury there would be dishonest.

subProducts.name: Capital
subProducts.blurb: Revenue-based financing offers for eligible Stripe merchants, repaid from a share of sales.
subProducts.note: No merchant-financing arena.

subProducts.name: Identity
subProducts.blurb: ID document verification, selfie matching, and SSN validation in 30+ countries.
subProducts.note: KYC identity verification, not developer login infrastructure — the auth-platforms arena (Auth0, Clerk, WorkOS) does a different job, so there is no honest fit.

subProducts.name: Financial Connections
subProducts.blurb: Permissioned access to customers' bank account data — balances, ownership, transactions — for ACH and underwriting.
subProducts.note: No bank-data-aggregation arena yet.

subProducts.name: Revenue Recognition
subProducts.blurb: Automated accrual accounting over Stripe transactions with audit-ready reports and GL export.
subProducts.note: A revenue subledger for Stripe data, not general-purpose accounting — the accounting arena (QuickBooks, Xero) isn't an honest fit.

subProducts.name: Sigma
subProducts.blurb: SQL reporting environment over your own Stripe data, inside the dashboard.
subProducts.note: Queries only your Stripe data — not a general warehouse, so the data-warehouses arena isn't an honest fit.

subProducts.name: Data Pipeline
subProducts.blurb: No-code export of Stripe data to Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery, Databricks, or cloud storage.
subProducts.note: A single-source export of Stripe's own data — the data-pipelines arena ranks general ELT platforms, so no honest fit.

subProducts.name: Managed Payments
subProducts.blurb: Merchant-of-record variant of Payments: Stripe handles tax, fraud, disputes, and transaction-level support for digital goods sellers.
subProducts.note: A merchant-of-record configuration of Payments — judged inside Stripe's payments entry, not as a separate competitor.

subProducts.name: Crypto & Stablecoins
subProducts.blurb: Stablecoin payments, payouts, and fiat-to-crypto onramp; stablecoin balances and card programs in preview.
subProducts.note: No stablecoin-rails arena yet.

subProducts.name: Agentic Commerce
subProducts.blurb: Agent-driven checkout: shared payment tokens, UCP/ACP protocol support, and machine payments for AI agents.
subProducts.note: No agentic-commerce arena yet and several pieces are still in preview; Stripe's agent surface (MCP server, agents.md) is already judged inside its payments entry's agenticness stories.

subProducts.name: Climate
subProducts.blurb: Carbon-removal purchasing: recurring revenue commitments or one-time orders via Frontier.

subProducts.note: A platform surface of the same workspace — its agent-facing capabilities (MCP server, GraphQL API, webhooks) are judged inside the parent entry's agenticness stories.

subProducts.name: Coding Sessions
subProducts.blurb: Delegate agentic coding from an issue: Claude Code or Codex runs in a sandbox, drafts PRs, and returns reviewable diffs — usage-priced via AI credits.
subProducts.note: Orchestrates third-party coding agents rather than being one — judging it in ai-coding against the very agents it hosts would double-count them.
